entry.title: Dr. Sangwook Park presented his research work at 2025 AIK conference

link.title: Dr. Sangwook Park presented his research work at 2025 AIK conference

entry.content:
Dr. Sangwook Park gave two presentations at the 2025 Architectural Institute of Korea (AIK).

  • Sangwook Park, “Seismic performance of steel moment-resisting frames with fuse connections under current design practices”
  • Sangwook Park, “Modeling and analysis of a moment-rotation behavior in composite steel gravity connections” (우수발표논문상)
entry.summary: Dr. Sangwook Park gave two presentations at the 2025 Architectural Institute of Korea (AIK).
